esco_skills.label: information structure
esco_skills.description: The type of infrastructure which defines the format of data: semi-structured, unstructured and structured.

esco_skills.label: domain name service
esco_skills.description: Naming database which maps internet domain names to Internet Protocol (IP) addresses. The Domain Name System allows internet users to utilise names such as website titles instead of remembering numeric IP addresses used by computers to locate a concrete website.

esco_skills.label: system backup best practice
esco_skills.description: The procedures related to preparing for recovery or continuation of technology infrastructure vital to an organisation.

esco_skills.label: distributed computing
esco_skills.description: The software process in which computer components interact over a network and send messages to communicate on their actions.

esco_skills.label: resource description framework query language
esco_skills.description: The query languages such as SPARQL which are used to retrieve and manipulate data stored in Resource Description Framework format (RDF).

esco_skills.label: query languages
esco_skills.description: The field of standardised computer languages for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information.

esco_skills.label: database development tools
esco_skills.description: The methodologies and tools used for creating logical and physical structure of databases, such as logical data structures, diagrams, modelling methodologies and entity-relationships.

esco_skills.label: data storage
esco_skills.description: The physical and technical concepts of how digital data storage is organised in specific schemes both locally, such as hard-drives and random-access memories (RAM) and remotely, via network, internet or cloud.

esco_skills.label: database management systems
esco_skills.description: The tools for creating, updating and managing databases, such as Oracle, MySQL and Microsoft SQL Server.

esco_skills.label: data quality assessment
esco_skills.description: The process of revealing data issues using ​quality indicators, measures and metrics in order to plan data cleansing and data enrichment strategies according to data quality criteria.

esco_skills.label: data models
esco_skills.description: The techniques and existing systems used for structuring data elements and showing relationships between them, as well as methods for interpreting the data structures and relationships.

esco_skills.label: define database physical structure
esco_skills.description: Specify the physical configuration of database files on a given media. This consists of in-detail specifications of indexing options, data types and data elements placed in the data dictionary.

esco_skills.label: use an application-specific interface
esco_skills.description: Understand and use interfaces particular to an application or use case.

esco_skills.label: administer ICT system
esco_skills.description: Handle components of ICT system by maintaining configuration, managing users, monitoring resource use, performing backups and installing hardware or software to comply with the set requirements.

esco_skills.label: apply company policies
esco_skills.description: Apply the principles and rules that govern the activities and processes of an organisation.

esco_skills.label: manage database
esco_skills.description: Apply database design schemes and models, define data dependencies, use query languages and database management systems (DBMS) to develop and manage databases.

esco_skills.label: use databases
esco_skills.description: Use software tools for managing and organising data in a structured environment which consists of attributes, tables and relationships in order to query and modify the stored data.

esco_skills.label: use scripting programming
esco_skills.description: Utilise specialised ICT tools to create computer code that is interpreted by the corresponding run-time environments in order to extend applications and automate common computer operations. Use programming languages which support this method such as Unix Shell scripts, JavaScript, Python and Ruby.

esco_skills.label: design database scheme
esco_skills.description: Draft a database scheme by following the Relational Database Management System (RDBMS) rules in order to create a logically arranged group of objects such as tables, columns and processes.

esco_skills.label: operate relational database management system
esco_skills.description: Extract, store and verify information using database management systems based on the relational database model, which arranges data into tables of rows and columns, such as Oracle Database, Microsoft SQL Server and MySQL.

esco_skills.label: perform ICT troubleshooting
esco_skills.description: Identify problems with servers, desktops, printers, networks, and remote access, and perform actions which solve the problems.

esco_skills.label: interpret technical texts
esco_skills.description: Read and understand technical texts that provide information on how to perform a task, usually explained in steps.

esco_skills.label: balance database resources
esco_skills.description: Stabilise the workload and resources of a database, by controlling the demand of transactions, allocating disk spaces and ensuring reliability of the servers in order to optimise cost and risk ratio.

esco_skills.label: design database backup specifications
esco_skills.description: Specify procedures to be performed on databases which ensure the copying and archiving of data for possible restoration in case of a data loss event.

esco_skills.label: perform backups
esco_skills.description: Implement backup procedures to backup data and systems to ensure permanent and reliable system operation. Execute data backups in order to secure information by copying and archiving to ensure integrity during system integration and after data loss occurrence.

esco_skills.label: maintain database performance
esco_skills.description: Calculate values for database parameters. Implement new releases and execute regular maintenance tasks such as establishing backup strategies and eliminating index fragmentation.

esco_skills.label: maintain database security
esco_skills.description: Master a wide variety of information security controls in order to pursue maximal database protection.

esco_skills.label: create data models
esco_skills.description: Use specific techniques and methodologies to analyse the data requirements of an organisation's business processes in order to create models for these data, such as conceptual, logical and physical models. These models have a specific structure and format.

esco_skills.label: business intelligence
esco_skills.description: The tools used to transform large amounts of raw data into relevant and helpful business information.

esco_skills.label: MDX
esco_skills.description: The computer language MDX is a query language for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information. It is developed by the software company Microsoft.

esco_skills.label: DB2
esco_skills.description: The computer program IBM DB2 is a tool for creating, updating and managing databases, developed by the software company IBM.

esco_skills.label: Microsoft Access
esco_skills.description: The computer program Access is a tool for creating, updating and managing databases, developed by the software company Microsoft.

esco_skills.label: XQuery
esco_skills.description: The computer language XQuery is a query language for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information. It is developed by the international standards organisation World Wide Web Consortium.

esco_skills.label: OpenEdge Database
esco_skills.description: The computer program OpenEdge Database is a tool for creating, updating and managing databases, developed by the software company Progress Software Corporation.

esco_skills.label: data engineering
esco_skills.description: The process of developing and constructing systems for implementing data collection and analysis at large scale.

esco_skills.label: ObjectStore
esco_skills.description: The computer program ObjectStore is a tool for creating, updating and managing databases, developed by the software company Object Design, Incorporated.

esco_skills.label: MySQL
esco_skills.description: The computer program MySQL is a tool for creating, updating and managing databases, currently developed by the software company Oracle.

esco_skills.label: TripleStore
esco_skills.description: The RDF store or TripleStore is a database used for storage and retrieval of Resource Description Framework triples (subject-predicate-object data entities) which can be accessed by semantic queries.

esco_skills.label: SPARQL
esco_skills.description: The computer language SPARQL is a query language for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information. It is developed by the international standards organisation World Wide Web Consortium.

esco_skills.label: IBM Informix
esco_skills.description: The computer program IBM Informix is a tool for creating, updating and managing databases, developed by the software company IBM.

esco_skills.label: LDAP
esco_skills.description: The computer language LDAP is a query language for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information.

esco_skills.label: PostgreSQL
esco_skills.description: The computer program PostgreSQL is a free and open-source software tool for creating, updating and managing databases, developed by the PostgreSQL Global Development Group.

esco_skills.label: online analytical processing
esco_skills.description: The online tools which analyse, aggregate and present multi-dimensional data enabling users to interactively and selectively extract and view data from specific points of view.

esco_skills.label: Filemaker (database management systems)
esco_skills.description: The computer program FileMaker is a tool for creating, updating and managing databases, developed by the software company FileMaker Inc.

esco_skills.label: SQL Server
esco_skills.description: The computer program SQL Server is a tool for creating, updating and managing databases, developed by the software company Microsoft.

esco_skills.label: quality assurance methodologies
esco_skills.description: Quality assurance principles, standard requirements, and the set of processes and activities used for measuring, controlling and ensuring the quality of products and processes.

esco_skills.label: LINQ
esco_skills.description: The computer language LINQ is a query language for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information. It is developed by the software company Microsoft.

esco_skills.label: Teradata Database
esco_skills.description: The computer program Teradata Database is a tool for creating, updating and managing databases, developed by the software company Teradata Corporation.

esco_skills.label: Oracle Relational Database
esco_skills.description: The computer program Oracle Rdb is a tool for creating, updating and managing databases, developed by the software company Oracle.

esco_skills.label: MarkLogic
esco_skills.description: The NoSQL enterprise non-relational database used for creating, updating and managing large amounts of unstructured data stored in the cloud and which provides features such as semantics, flexible data models and Hadoop integration.

esco_skills.label: N1QL
esco_skills.description: The computer language N1QL is a query language for retrieval of information from a database and of documents containing the needed information. It is developed by the software company Couchbase.

esco_skills.label: implement ICT security policies
esco_skills.description: Implement statements, assertions or rules that specify the appropriate use and protection of the ICT assets and systems from an organisation. These ICT security policies cover topics such as data classification, password management, access control and incident response.

esco_skills.label: use spreadsheets software
esco_skills.description: Use software tools to create and edit tabular data to carry out mathematical calculations, organise data and information, create diagrams based on data and to retrieve them.

esco_skills.label: protect personal data and privacy
esco_skills.description: Protect personal data and privacy in digital environments. Understand how to use and share personally identifiable information while being able to protect oneself and others from damages. Understand that digital services use a “Privacy policy” to inform how personal data is used.

esco_skills.label: use different communication channels
esco_skills.description: Make use of various types of communication channels such as verbal, handwritten, digital and telephonic communication with the purpose of constructing and sharing ideas or information.

esco_skills.label: use automatic programming
esco_skills.description: Utilise specialised software tools to generate computer code from specifications, such as diagrams, structured informations or other means of describing functionality.

esco_skills.label: execute ICT audits
esco_skills.description: Organise and execute audits in order to evaluate ICT systems, compliance of components of systems, information processing systems and information security. Identify and collect potential critical issues and recommend solutions based on required standards and solutions.

esco_skills.label: design database in the cloud
esco_skills.description: Apply design principles for an adaptive, elastic, automated, loosely coupled databases making use of cloud infrastructure. Aim to remove any single point of failure through distributed database design.

esco_skills.label: use back-up and recovery tools
esco_skills.description: Use tools which allow users to copy and archive computer software, configurations and data and recover them in case of loss.

esco_skills.label: remove computer virus or malware from a computer
esco_skills.description: Carry out actions to remove computer viruses or other types of malware from a computer.

esco_skills.label: implement anti-virus software
esco_skills.description: Download, install and update software to prevent, detect and remove malicious software, such as computer viruses.

esco_skills.label: provide ICT support
esco_skills.description: Resolve ICT-related incidents and service requests from customers, clients or colleagues including password resets and updating databases such as Microsoft Exchange email.

esco_skills.label: manage cloud data and storage
esco_skills.description: Create and manage cloud data retention. Identify and implement data protection, encryption, and capacity planning needs.

esco_skills.label: provide technical training
esco_skills.description: Explain and demonstrate the use of training equipment and system functions.

esco_skills.label: support ICT system users
esco_skills.description: Communicate with end users, instruct them on how to progress with tasks, use ICT support tools and methods to solve problems and identify possible side effects and provide solutions.

esco_skills.label: estimate duration of work
esco_skills.description: Produce accurate calculations on time necessary to fulfil future technical tasks based on past and present information and observations or plan the estimated duration of individual tasks in a given project.

esco_skills.label: implement a firewall
esco_skills.description: Download, install and update a network security system designed to prevent unauthorized access to a private network.

matched_clo.clo_text:
Ditujukan untuk memberikan pembelajaran kepada mahasiswa mengenai pemodelan data dalam memenuhi kebutuhan pengembangan perangkat lunak tertentu. Mata kuliah ini juga memiliki tujuan untuk membentuk kompetensi analisa dan perancangan terstruktur dengan pendekatan relational data dari suatu kebutuhan penyimpanan data untuk mendukung pengembangan perangkat lunak yang terdefinisi. Penggunaan alat-alat bantu pemodelan, penerapan metodologi dan teknik-teknik yang umum digunakan, serta pendokumentasian model data mulai dari abstraksi konseptual sampai dengan model fisik juga menjadi outcomes dari perkuliahan ini. Mahasiswa akan belajar mengenai bagaimana mengumpulkan informasi dalam rangka mengidentifikasi permasalahan-permasalahan yang akan diselesaikan, mendefinisikan persyaratan-persyaratan sistem melalui analisa, dan melakukan perancangan konseptual, lojikal dan fisikal untuk suatu kebutuhan perangkat lunak tertentu.

Prasyarat untuk matakuliah ini adalah mahasiswa sudah pernah mengikuti dan lulus mata kuliah Struktur Data & Algoritma, serta Matematika Diskrit. Dianjurkan juga mahasiswa memliki pengetahuan dan keahlian dalam Tata Tulis Teknik dalam bahasa Indonesia maupun dalam Bahasa Inggris. Setelah menyelesaikan mata kuliah ini, mahasiswa dapat mendemonstrasikan pengetahuan dan pemahamannya, serta kemampuannya dalam menerapkan konsep-konsep, prinsip-prinsip desain data yang berkaitan dengan struktur data dan manipulasinya serta relevansinya dalam sebuah sistem
basis data. Mahasiswa juga dapat mengabstraksi dan mengungkapkan pemeringkatan Model Data khususnya model data relasional. Perkuliahan dilaksanakan dengan Metode pembelajaran kolaboratif yang dijalankan secara Hybrid/Blended Learning. Penilaian dilakukan berdasarkan capaian pembelajaran yang telah ditentukan pada masing-masing bahasan, melalui penugasan individu dan kelompok, tes formatif dan tes sumatif.

Dalam kuliah Struktur Data dan Algoritma ini diuraikan hal-hal yang berkaitan dengan penentuan dan pemilihan struktur data yang tepat untuk menyelesaikan masalah komputasi. Diawali
dengan pemahaman akan alokasi dan representasi data serta pembentukan abstract data type (ADT). Konsep ADT mendasari implementasi user defined data type baik dalam struktur linier
maupun struktur hirarki (tree). Setelah memahami alokasi dan representasi data di primary memory, di akhir semester juga diulas struktur/organisasi file data yang dapat dijadikan awal

Mata kuliah Matematika Diskrit 1 ini dirancang untuk memberikan  pemahaman  yang  kuat  tentang  konsep-konsep  matematika  diskrit  dan  menerapkannya  dalam  pemecahan  masalah  di  bidang  informatika.  Fokus  utamanya  adalah  pada  penerapan  logika,  teori  himpunan,  relasi  dan  fungsi,  kombinatorial,  dan  teori  bilangan  untuk  menyelesaikan  kasus  nyata  dalam  ilmu  komputer.

Mata kuliah ini dibagi menjadi lima bagian besar:

- Logika: Meliputi prinsip-prinsip logika, operator logika, dan penerapannya dalam ilmu komputer.
- Teori Himpunan: Meliputi konsep himpunan, operasi himpunan, dan penerapannya dalam representasi data dan algoritma.
- Relasi dan Fungsi: Meliputi relasi, fungsi, dan penerapannya dalam pemodelan hubungan antar objek diskrit.
- Kombinatorial: Meliputi prinsip-prinsip pencacahan, permutasi, kombinasi, dan penerapannya dalam analisis algoritma dan probabilitas.
- Teori Bilangan: Meliputi bilangan bulat, pembagian, faktorisasi, kongruensi, dan penerapannya dalam kriptografi dan keamanan komputer.

Setelah menyelesaikan mata kuliah ini, mahasiswa diharapkan mampu:

- Memahami prinsip-prinsip dan teknik matematika diskrit dalam menyelesaikan masalah di bidang informatika.
- Menerapkan logika, teori himpunan, relasi dan fungsi, kombinatorial, dan teori bilangan dalam kalkulasi dan analisis matematika standar dalam ilmu komputer.
 - Menggunakan pengetahuan matematika diskrit untuk menyelesaikan kasus nyata di bidang informatika.
 - Mengembangkan kemampuan berpikir logis, analitis, dan sistematis dalam menyelesaikan masalah.

Dengan  menekankan  pada  penerapan  dan  penyelesaian  kasus  nyata,  mata  kuliah  ini  bertujuan  untuk  membekali  mahasiswa  dengan  fondasi  matematika  diskrit  yang  kuat  untuk  studi  lanjut  di  bidang  informatika.

Mata kuliah ini mempelajari konsep dari komunikasi data dan jaringan komputer yang mencakup berbagai aspek terkait dengan komunikasi data dan jaringan komputer, dan distrukturkan berdasarkan model komunikasi data berlapis. Dalam hal ini, digunakan model komunikasi data berlapis yang berlaku umum dan telah terimplementasi, yakni model TCP/IP. Mata kuliah Matematika Diskrit 1 ini dirancang untuk memberikan  pemahaman  yang  kuat  tentang  konsep-konsep  matematika  diskrit  dan  menerapkannya  dalam  pemecahan  masalah  di  bidang  informatika.  Fokus  utamanya  adalah  pada  penerapan  logika,  teori  himpunan,  relasi  dan  fungsi,  kombinatorial,  dan  teori  bilangan  untuk  menyelesaikan  kasus  nyata  dalam  ilmu  komputer.

Mata kuliah ini dibagi menjadi lima bagian besar:

- Logika: Meliputi prinsip-prinsip logika, operator logika, dan penerapannya dalam ilmu komputer.
- Teori Himpunan: Meliputi konsep himpunan, operasi himpunan, dan penerapannya dalam representasi data dan algoritma.
- Relasi dan Fungsi: Meliputi relasi, fungsi, dan penerapannya dalam pemodelan hubungan antar objek diskrit.
- Kombinatorial: Meliputi prinsip-prinsip pencacahan, permutasi, kombinasi, dan penerapannya dalam analisis algoritma dan probabilitas.
- Teori Bilangan: Meliputi bilangan bulat, pembagian, faktorisasi, kongruensi, dan penerapannya dalam kriptografi dan keamanan komputer.

Setelah menyelesaikan mata kuliah ini, mahasiswa diharapkan mampu:

- Memahami prinsip-prinsip dan teknik matematika diskrit dalam menyelesaikan masalah di bidang informatika.
- Menerapkan logika, teori himpunan, relasi dan fungsi, kombinatorial, dan teori bilangan dalam kalkulasi dan analisis matematika standar dalam ilmu komputer.
 - Menggunakan pengetahuan matematika diskrit untuk menyelesaikan kasus nyata di bidang informatika.
 - Mengembangkan kemampuan berpikir logis, analitis, dan sistematis dalam menyelesaikan masalah.

Dengan  menekankan  pada  penerapan  dan  penyelesaian  kasus  nyata,  mata  kuliah  ini  bertujuan  untuk  membekali  mahasiswa  dengan  fondasi  matematika  diskrit  yang  kuat  untuk  studi  lanjut  di  bidang  informatika.
